import random
import string

def generate_test_case():
    s_length = random.randint(1, 20)
    p_length = random.randint(1, 20)

    s = ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase) for _ in range(s_length))

    p = ""
    valid_chars = string.ascii_lowercase + ".*"
    while len(p) < p_length:
        char = random.choice(valid_chars)
        if char == "*":
            if len(p) == 0 or p[-1] == "*":
                continue
        p += char

    return s, p
